collection.title: Peugeot 5008 2009 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Peugeot 5008 2009 to 2017 requires a 32" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 27" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this 5008 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
